snippet.title: Whispers of the Tallgrass: Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Get your first look at the creepy Whispers of the Tallgrass, an upcoming first-person atmospheric survival horror game in which players must evade a stubborn predator amidst the tall grass of the abandoned and overgrown industrial wasteland, scavenging for survival and, uncovering the secrets behind what happened here, and hopefully, escaping. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4544620/Whispers_of_the_Tallgrass

#IGN #Gaming
